scenes.title: Eugene walks straight to the kitchen snack cabinet despite failing the house map test
scenes.era: 1999, suburban California home and UC San Diego neuropsychological testing visit

layout.description: Bright sunlit 1990s suburban dining table opening directly into a wooden-cabinet kitchen. At the dining table lies a blank sheet of white paper and a graphite pencil where the elderly patient failed to sketch his floor plan; in the background, the patient walks unhesitatingly to the upper oak cabinet and opens the door to take a jar of nuts.

positions.who: Patient Eugene (elderly mannequin in 1990s plaid cardigan and slacks)
positions.where: walking smoothly from the dining table straight to the upper wooden kitchen cabinet

positions.who: Neuropsychologist (mannequin in collared shirt with clipboard)
positions.where: standing beside the dining table holding the blank floor-plan sheet
positions.facing: watching Eugene open the exact cabinet in astonishment

props.name: blank floor-plan sketch sheet and pencil
props.period_detail: white 8.5x11 testing sheet with only an uncertain rectangle drawn on it
props.physical_behavior: rests untouched on the dining table after Eugene shook his head

props.name: oak kitchen snack cabinet
props.period_detail: 1990s raised-panel wooden upper cabinet above the counter
props.physical_behavior: swings open smoothly on metal hinges as Eugene reaches the exact handle without hesitation

props.name: glass snack jar
props.period_detail: clear glass jar filled with roasted nuts inside the cabinet
props.physical_behavior: lifted cleanly onto the countertop in one practiced motion

actions.verb_sequence: sets the pencil down beside the blank house map -> rises from the chair -> walks straight into the kitchen and pulls open the exact snack cabinet
lowers the clipboard -> looks from the blank paper sheet to Eugene's hand lifting the jar

reactions.reaction: calmly unscrews the snack jar lid with practiced ease while unable to name which room comes next
leans forward beside the table, stunned by the split between zero conscious map and flawless habit

scenes.wardrobe: Patient Eugene: 1990s earth-tone cardigan sweater over collared shirt and khaki trousers. Neuropsychologist: light blue Oxford shirt, tie, dark slacks.
scenes.lighting: High-key natural California morning daylight streaming across the dining table and wooden kitchen cabinets.
scenes.recognition_hook: An amnesic man who cannot draw a single room of his own home walks straight to the kitchen cabinet and grabs his snacks without pausing.

key_visual.description: the amnesic patient leaves a blank floor plan on the table and walks straight to open the kitchen cabinet for snacks

scenes.title: Failed conscious recall on the eight-pair object table

layout.description: Clean clinical testing room with pairs of everyday small objects arranged on a wooden table above hidden paper markers.

positions.where: seated across the testing table reaching under the correct object

props.name: eight pairs of household test objects
props.period_detail: small plastic and wooden objects concealing a printed 'correct' target strip underneath one item per pair
props.physical_behavior: Eugene's hand lifts the winning object accurately 85 percent of the time

props.name: session tally pad
props.period_detail: lined clinical score sheet marking Session 1 through Session 36
props.physical_behavior: pen checks off another correct choice

actions.verb_sequence: shakes his head denying he has ever seen the test -> reaches out and picks up the exact correct object

reactions.reaction: records the 85 percent score while Eugene looks puzzled by his own right hand

scenes.wardrobe: Same 1990s cardigan on Eugene; blue Oxford shirt on Neuropsychologist.
scenes.recognition_hook: Picking the winning object 85 percent of the time while swearing he has never seen the game before.

scenes.title: T-maze cue-triggered habit run and start-end bracketing

layout.description: High-key neuroscience laboratory featuring an acrylic T-shaped runway with an audible tone speaker at the center junction and two small food wells at the left and right arms.

positions.where: poised at the start gate of the acrylic T-maze, then sprinting cleanly into the cued arm
positions.facing: facing down the center stem toward the turn

positions.who: MIT researcher mannequin in white lab coat
positions.where: standing beside the maze monitor rack

props.name: acrylic T-maze with sliding start gate
props.period_detail: clear laboratory T-maze with vertical start barrier and two end reward wells
props.physical_behavior: gate slides upward, releasing the porcelain rat into a rapid smooth turn

props.name: oscilloscope waveform monitor
props.period_detail: benchtop display showing two sharp firing peaks at gate-open and goal-arrival with flat middle trace
props.physical_behavior: trace brackets the start and finish of the run

actions.verb_sequence: bolts forward the instant the gate lifts -> banks smoothly left at the tone -> stops precisely at the end well

reactions.reaction: points to the two sharp start-and-end waveform peaks framing the silent middle segment

scenes.wardrobe: MIT researcher in crisp white laboratory coat over dark trousers; articulated matte-white porcelain rat sculpture.
scenes.recognition_hook: The T-maze run compresses into two sharp start-and-finish bursts in the deep striatum.

scenes.title: Swapping the routine attached to an everyday cue

layout.description: Bright modern kitchen at evening where a bowl of sliced fruit sits in front of the old snack cabinet door.

positions.where: standing at the kitchen counter as a wall clock hits 10:00
seated at the island with a mug of herbal tea

props.name: ceramic fruit bowl
props.period_detail: white ceramic bowl placed directly on the counter at eye level
props.physical_behavior: hand reaches for an apple slice instead of the upper cabinet handle

actions.verb_sequence: walks into the kitchen on the 10:00 cue -> redirects hand from the upper cabinet to lift a slice of fruit

reactions.reaction: nods calmly as the new reward closes the evening bracket

scenes.wardrobe: Casual modern knit sweater and trousers.
scenes.recognition_hook: Keeping the cue and reward while replacing the middle routine rewires the striatal bracket.
